messages:
deploy-bot: Initiating v2 staged rollout -> prod (slice-3). target=10% global, initial=6%. scheduled ramp at 18:00 UTC. /deploy start
Anya: Quick FYI: a subset of mobile SDKs (<=1.4.2) don't send the new header signal. Recommend we keep conservative ramp and pin those clients to v1.
Rick: Noticed a short spike in eu-west-1 during the canary. p50 unchanged, p95 +35ms, 5xx ~0.85%. alerts triggered.
deploy-bot: Canary summary:
```
slice: slice-2
p95_delta: +35ms
5xx_rate: 0.85% (alert threshold 0.5%)
```
Sam: Hold the global ramp. Let's route eu-west-1 traffic for mobile clients back to v1 and keep global at 6%. Avoid global rollback unless fallback doesn't stabilize. @Lee can you apply routing?
Anya: I'll add header-based pin rules for legacy SDK user-agents so they remain on v1 until patched. Also drafting a short release note blurb about header-case normalization and client routing.
Lee: Oncall here. Starting rollback runbook but will attempt regional fallback first. If we need a full revert I'll execute the revert play.
deploy-bot: Traffic policy applied: eu-west-1 -> v1 for filters: `client:mobile OR tenant:legacy-*`. policy_id=rp-2024.
Priya: Ops: did the eu-west fallback restore healthy metrics?
Rick: After applying policy: eu-west 5xx dropped to 0.1% in ~3m, p95 back to baseline. Good signal. Suggest cautious resume: schedule next ramp to 12% in 10m and keep mobile pins until SDK patch lands.
Sam: +1. Set auto-hold if 5xx >0.4% or p95 increases >100ms within next 30m.
Anya: I'll update the launch notes: "v2 normalizes header case; legacy mobile SDKs may be routed to v1 — see migration guide." Also pinged SDK team for a patch.
deploy-bot: Rollout state: global=6% (eu-west pinned->v1). next_ramp=12% at 1723457400 UTC pending ops OK.
Lee: Ops watching dashboards. If stable, approve ramp at scheduled time; else hold and escalate.
Sam: I'll post a short note to #release with the temporary pin and guidance for customers.
Priya: Quick revert snippet for runbook:
```
# quick revert
/deploy revert --policy rp-2024 --scope global
```
Rick: No new alerts in last 6m. Monitoring continues.
Lee: ops-ack. Will report back at 12m check-in with final status.
Anya: After patch from SDK team lands we'll lift pins and resume normal ramp. Leaving this thread open for operator updates.
